'''The Lodha Mathematical Sciences Institute''' ('''LMSI''')<ref>{{cite news |date=2025-08-18 |title=India gets its first privately funded institute for maths research |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/india-gets-its-first-privately-funded-institute-for-maths-research/articleshow/123352435.cms |location=Mumbai |publisher=The Times of India}}
</ref> is a mathematical [[research centre]] located in [[Mumbai]], India.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/lodha-foundation-unveils-privately-funded-mathematical-sciences-institute-in-mumbai/article69943928.ece|title=Lodha Foundation unveils privately funded Mathematical Sciences Institute in Mumbai|website=The Hindu |date=17 August 2025 }}
</ref> It is India's only private mathematics research institute,<ref>{{cite news |date=2025-08-08 |title=The arithmetic of philanthropy: Lodha Foundation to set up India’s first private maths institute in Mumbai |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/mumbai-news/the-arithmetic-of-philanthropy-lodha-foundation-to-set-up-india-s-1st-privately-funded-maths-institute-in-mumbai-101754594180256.html |location=Mumbai |publisher=Hindustan Times}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |date=2025-08-17 |title=Mumbai gets India’s first private maths research institute, Indian Fields Medalist on advisory board |url=https://theprint.in/india/education/mumbai-gets-indias-1st-private-maths-research-institute-indian-fields-medalist-on-advisory-board/2722690/ |location=New Delhi |publisher=ThePrint}}
</ref> inaugurated on August 17, 2025, in Mumbai.

== Mission and Vision ==
'''Mission''' - LMSI fosters an inclusive, collaborative, and meritocratic environment where mathematical ideas - from India and across the world - are explored, advanced, and shared for the greater good of humanity.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://lmsi.org/|title=Mission and Vision}}</ref>

'''Vision''' -  LMSI<ref>{{cite news |date=2025-08-19 |title=India’s first private mathematics research institute launched in Mumbai |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/education-today/news/story/indias-first-private-mathematics-institute-launched-in-mumbai-2773439-2025-08-19 |location=New Delhi |publisher=India Today}}
</ref> aspires to be a global leader in mathematical research - both fundamental and applied - to help build a better world.

==Leadership==
The institute is led by [[V. Kumar Murty]], an esteemed mathematician known for his contributions to number theory and arithmetic geometry. Dr. Murty holds a Ph.D. from Harvard and has served as the Director of the Fields Institute as well as a professor at the University of Toronto.<ref>{{cite web |date=August 2025|title=India's first private maths research institute comes up in Mumbai, Fields Medal winner Manjul Bhargava on advisory council|url=https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/mumbai/india-first-private-maths-research-institute-mumbai-fields-medal-winner-manjul-bhargava-advisory-council-10196319|website=The Indian Express}}</ref>

== Scientific Advisory Panel ==

LMSI is guided by a distinguished advisory panel of leading international researchers, including:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://lmsi.org/scientific-advisory-panel|title=Scientific Advisory Panel}}</ref>

# [[Manjul Bhargava]] (Princeton University)
# [[Vikraman Balaji]] (Chennai Mathematical Institute)
# [[Sourav Chatterjee]] (Stanford University)
# [[Ravi Vakil]] (Stanford University; President-Elect of AMS)
# [[Yakov Eliashberg]] (Stanford University)
# [[Alexander Lubotzky]] (Weizmann Institute of Science)
# [[Kavita Ramanan]] (Brown University)
# [[François Labourie]] (Université de Nice Sophia Antipolis)
# Siddhartha Mishra (ETH Zurich)
# [[Mahan Mj]] (TIFR)
# [[Ngô Bảo Châu]] (University of Chicago)
# [[Raman Parimala]] (Emory University)
